swarmintelligence.name: Swarm Intelligence: No Leader, Yet Coordinated
swarmintelligence.truth: No leader, yet coordinated. Stigmergy: the environment is the message. Local rules produce global intelligence.
swarmintelligence.qfep_connection: Swarm systems operate at the edge of chaos—the λ parameter that modulates between order and entropy. φΔE(S,t) manifests as collective adaptive capacity: the swarm's rate of entropy change determines its survival.
swarmintelligence.demonstration: Watch boids flock without a leader. See ants find shortest paths through pheromone trails. Observe particles converge on optima through collective memory.
swarmintelligence.description: Collective behavior and distributed intelligence. Individual agents follow simple local rules, yet global coordination emerges. This is queer intelligence—non-hierarchical, decentralized, resistant to single points of failure.
